meeting: VPP Insiders discussion of the Brattle report on VPP costs
note: A critique session on a published report, so it is thick with figures that are easy to half-remember and get wrong — which is the point. Attributed by speaker label only; participants use first names in speech and this key does not carry them.

facts.canonical: on resource adequacy alone a VPP is roughly 40 to 60 percent the cost of the alternatives
aliases: VPP is 40 to 60 percent the cost of alternative options
facts.evidence: Found that looking at resource adequacy alone, that a VVP is roughly 40 to 60 percent the cost of alternative options.

facts.canonical: the modelled case is 400 megawatts of DERs replacing a traditional gas peaker
aliases: 400 megawatts of DERs to replace a traditional gas peaker
facts.evidence: Using the example of I believe a 400 megawatts of um DERs to replace a traditional gas peaker

facts.evidence: One and a half power walls per home, um, which is pretty big for only getting paid like 500 bucks a year or something.

facts.canonical: batteries are paid about 500 dollars a year while providing seven and a half kW

facts.evidence: Like seven and a half kw for 500 bucks.
